title: The Generative Gap Between Speculative Drafter and Continuous Diffusion Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.40847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) and speculative drafters offer efficient language generation but are typically evaluated differently: CDLMs generate independently through iterative refinement, whereas drafters propose text for target-model verification and correction. We compare their architectures without verification, using LangFlow for CDLMs and adapting DSpark's Markov and recurrent-head architectures for standalone generation. All models are trained from scratch for unconditional, single-block OpenWebText generation at lengths 16, 128, and 1024, without target features or verification, using common preprocessing, backbone dimensions, and training-update budgets. We evaluate generation perplexity (GenPPL) with an external language model and distributional similarity to reference text with MAUVE. With default denoising steps equal to sequence length, LangFlow outperforms both DSpark variants on both metrics at lengths 128

translated_title: 投机草稿模型与连续扩散语言模型之间的生成差距
translated_abstract: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLMs）和投机草稿模型都能实现高效的语言生成，但它们的评估方式通常不同：CDLMs 通过迭代细化独立生成文本，而草稿模型提出的文本则需经目标模型验证和修正。我们在无验证的条件下比较了这两种架构：CDLMs 采用 LangFlow，草稿模型则改造 DSpark 的马尔可夫和循环头架构用于独立生成。所有模型均从零开始训练，在长度为 16、128 和 1024 的 OpenWebText 上进行无条件、单块生成，不使用目标模型特征或验证，并采用相同的预处理方法、骨干网络维度和训练更新预算。我们使用外部语言模型评估生成困惑度，并使用 MAUVE 评估与参考文本的分布相似性。在默认去噪步数等于序列长度的设置下，LangFlow 在长度为 128 的文本上于两项指标均优于 DSpark 的两种变体。
tldr: 该研究在无目标模型验证的公平条件下，从零训练并比较连续扩散语言模型与投机草稿架构，发现基于 CDLM 的 LangFlow 在生成困惑度和 MAUVE 指标上均优于 DSpark 的草稿架构。
en_tdlr: Under fair verification-free conditions with models trained from scratch, this study compares continuous diffusion language models with speculative drafter architectures, showing that LangFlow (CDLM) outperforms both DSpark drafter variants on generation perplexity and MAUVE metrics.
